text: Picnic is funded by its shareholders, which include German supermarket chain Edeka, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Trust and well-known Dutch family businesses; the company was founded in 2015 by Michiel Muller, Frederik Nieuwenhuys, Joris Beckers and Bas Verheijen.

source.name: Silicon Canals: Amsterdam's Picnic gets €355M funding; grows 40% to €1.25B in turnover in 2023
source.quote: has secured €355M in a fresh round of funding from its shareholders, including German supermarket chain Edeka, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Trust, and well-known Dutch family businesses
